text.card: A red giant 2,364 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.91 solar masses and 15.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,624 K at its surface.
